نبذة

Ethereal Beauty is a tranquil sanctuary dedicated to enhancing natural beauty through a range of nurturing treatments. This women-owned haven specialises in personalised care, offering services in beauty & wellness. Everything skin, brows, nails, body, to spirituality, every appointment designed so you leave feeling relaxed and beautiful. With skilled therapists prioritising comfort and well-being, each appointment is more than just a service… it's an experience that rejuvenates both body and spirit. We look forward to welcoming you into our little slice of heaven🤍 Lots of love The ethereal Family
